name: 8bit-pixel-art
title_zh: 稀疏像素画：大片留白里只点几个关键色块
tagline_zh: 给抽象文案或一张照片，输出杂志感稀疏像素图。自动去噪、只留主体，边缘柔化不糊，适合封面或社交配图，不是满屏马赛克。
tagline_en: Turn a brief or photo into editorial sparse 8-bit art. Keeps dominant subjects, drops noise, soft edges — for.
desc_en: Create sparse abstract Instagram/editorial 8-bit pixel artwork from a natural-language brief, or distill an uploaded photo into either a soft-edged coarse-pixel subject cluster on a clean portrait paper field or an intentional edge-to-edge pixel composition when the source calls for full bleed. Use for `create` and `fuse`; prioritize dominant subjects, omit low-value detail, and never use a hard p
why_zh: 它懂“少即是多”：先识别主体，再刻意省略低价值细节，像素点像手摆的，不是算法硬压。
why_en: It understands less-is-more: detects subjects, omits noise, places pixels like a designer. Soft edges give coarse pixels a.
limit_zh: 只输出静态单帧像素图，不做动画、不做多尺寸适配。源图需主体明确；极端杂乱场景会过度简化。硬边像素风格不在其设计内。
limit_en: Static single-frame only; no animation or multi-size output. Needs clear subject; cluttered scenes over-simplify. Hard-edge pixel style not supported.
